scrape-execution.custom-headers.evidence: a436397, 3e20c60, 4b7ce20: `headers` on scrape, batch and crawl (REST, SDK, MCP, /fc), at most 32 lower-cased RFC 7230 names with values of at most 4096 characters; user-agent, sec-ch-*, sec-fetch-*, authorization, proxy-authorization, cookie and the transport headers are refused by name with HTTP 400. The http lane sends them to the requested origin after the identity and withholds them from a cross-origin hop (custom_headers_withheld); the browser lane sends them with the document and its same-origin requests, records a server redirect that carried them on (custom_headers_forwarded), and its signed sentHeaders carry them as sent. Both lanes record request_headers_added; robots.txt gets the identity alone; a request with headers skips the vendor rungs (ladder_channels_filtered). Live: httpbin echoes X-Test and Accept-Language beside the declared User-Agent, a User-Agent header is HTTP 400 naming it, and scrapethissite's header gotcha answers 200 with the header and 400 without (m2-live-checks-execution-2026-10-02.md A, B, C). Tests: contracts api.test.ts, bench pageOptions.test.ts, api executionOptions.test.ts, mcp tools.test.ts, contracts firecrawl.test.ts.

scrape-execution.mobile-emulation.evidence: a436397, 3e20c60, 4b7ce20: `mobile` on scrape, batch and crawl (REST, SDK, MCP, /fc), refused with research mode. A second declared identity, Android 14 Pixel 7 Chrome with the same major, sec-ch-ua-mobile ?1, platform Android, a 412x915 touch viewport at 2.625, passing identityBundleIssues and checkIdentityHonesty; the http lane sends it and evaluates robots.txt against it (identity_sent.device), the browser lane opens the mobile fingerprint, declares it (identity_declared), sets Chromium's user-agent metadata so its own hints and navigator.userAgentData agree, and its compliance record carries the mobile User-Agent and hints as sent (schemaVersion 2 has no device field). Live: Wikipedia Web_scraping answered 200 to the mobile identity on the http lane with the declared Android User-Agent and hints sent, robots allowed, no identity_mismatch; no redirect to en.m.wikipedia.org was observed (m2-live-checks-execution-2026-10-02.md D). Tests: contracts identityBundle.test.ts, bench pageOptions.test.ts (a responsive page sees Android, 412 CSS pixels and touch), api executionOptions.test.ts (stored on a crawl, its pages carry the identity).

scrape-execution.skip-tls-verification.evidence: a436397, 3e20c60, 4b7ce20: by default a certificate that does not verify is failed/tls_error on both lanes with the error code in request_failed (also when robots.txt fails on it), never connection_error or policy_denied; `skipTlsVerification` relaxes verification for one local fetch and its robots.txt lookup through routes of its own, closed after it (the shared routes, the robots cache's own and the delivery worker keep verifying), the browser lane opens ignoreHTTPSErrors, and every result carries tls_verification_skipped and a tls_unverified warning; ApiEngineOptions.hosted (set by --hosted and the hosted MCP host) refuses it with HTTP 400 before any fetch. Live: self-signed.badssl.com and expired.badssl.com are failed/tls_error with DEPTH_ZERO_SELF_SIGNED_CERT and CERT_HAS_EXPIRED by default, answer HTTP 200 through the proxy tunnel under the option with the warning, the event and a real robots verdict (the heading-only pages are empty_unverified by the error model), and a hosted API refuses the option by name (m2-live-checks-execution-2026-10-02.md E-A to E-E). Tests: bench tlsVerification.test.ts (openssl self-signed server, both lanes), http-core resilient.test.ts, api executionOptions.test.ts.

scrape-execution.fast-mode.evidence: a436397, 4b7ce20: `fastMode` on scrape, batch and crawl (REST, SDK, MCP, /fc) keeps the http rung alone, refused by name for a URL the channel policy binds to the browser lane; the ladder audit opens with ladder_channels_filtered { reason: fastMode, dropped }, the http rung's verdict is the answer, and a scrape whose http rung asked for the browser rung carries agentHints naming fastMode. Live: quotes.toscrape.com/js/ is failed/empty_unverified on the http rung alone with browserMs 0, the filtered event and the hint, and quotes.toscrape.com/ is success with the ten quotes on the http rung alone (m2-live-checks-execution-2026-10-02.md F). Tests: api executionOptions.test.ts (counting browser seam, batch, browser_only refusal), contracts api.test.ts, mcp tools.test.ts, contracts firecrawl.test.ts.

scrape-execution.block-ads.evidence: a436397, 3e20c60, 4b7ce20: `blockAds` (default true) on scrape, batch and crawl (REST, SDK, MCP, /fc); the local browser lane aborts, before any connection, requests to a bundled list of 53 reviewed ad-serving hosts (adHosts.ts, host or dot-suffix) and records ads_blocked { count, hosts }; the hosted browser keeps its allowlist whatever the option says. Live, local fixture: a script-written page naming pagead2.googlesyndication.com and ad.doubleclick.net gets ads_blocked count 2 with both hosts and Markdown without the ad container; the false case ran against loopback stand-ins only, both of which were loaded (m2-live-checks-execution-2026-10-02.md G). No frozen test-set row names the feature. Tests: bench blockAds.test.ts (adHosts seam, both cases).

scrape-formats.block-ads.evidence: a436397, 3e20c60: ExtractorOptions.blockAds (default true) switches the extractor's ad-container and cookie-banner pruning, which was always on, so default Markdown and html are unchanged (EXTRACTOR_VERSION stays extract-tf/5, pinned by version.test.ts) and `blockAds: false` keeps ads and cookie banners in markdown and html on every lane; rawHtml is always the page as received. Live, local fixture: with the default neither markdown nor html contains the ad container and with false both do (m2-live-checks-execution-2026-10-02.md G). Tests: extract-tf extract.test.ts and markdown.test.ts (default removes, false keeps, a `download` class is never pruned), bench blockAds.test.ts.

scrape-execution.execution-metadata.evidence: 78fce32, 7522f09: every scrape response's `metadata` (full and compact; /fc data.metadata with creditsUsed: null) carries scrapeId (a UUID per call, also at the top of the full response), sourceURL, url, statusCode, contentType, proxyUsed (operator from evidence.envProxy / egress_proxy, user from the compliance record's egressOwner, else null), timezone (the browser lane's declared zone, null on the HTTP lane) and the concurrency pair, beside the page fields (null on a page not read as content); no cacheState or cachedAt. The call's record without any page body (request with header values replaced by names, origin, integration, verdict, lanes, metadata, snapshot, usage, warnings, agentHints) is written to <taskRoot>/scrapes/<scrapeId>.json before the response is sent and served by GET /v1/scrapes/:id (SDK getScrape, MCP get_scrape; 404 not_found for an unknown or malformed id); a write failure is logged and traced (scrape_record_unwritten). Live: the Wikipedia population page answered with sourceURL and url equal to the requested URL, canonicalUrl the canonical page, a UUID scrapeId, proxyUsed operator, timezone null, concurrencyLimited false, and GET /v1/scrapes/<id> returned the record with the same url, status and lane and no markdown (m2-live-checks-execution-signals-2026-10-02.md A). Tests: api app.test.ts (ids, facts, record, 404, header names, /fc keys), contracts firecrawl.test.ts (wrapScrape passes the facts through), sdk client.test.ts (getScrape), mcp tools.test.ts (get_scrape).

scrape-execution.concurrency-queue-signa.evidence: 78fce32: OriginScheduler.pump marks every waiter held while all slots are taken and measures the hold (OriginPermit.limitedByConcurrency, concurrencyWaitMs, never more than the wait outside a cooldown); both local lanes carry it as usage.timings.concurrencyWaitMs when the permit was held (batch items and crawl pages included), and the API sums it over the run's attempts into metadata.concurrencyQueueDurationMs with concurrencyLimited true when any attempt was held, on the full and compact responses and /fc. queueMs keeps its meaning. Live: three concurrent scrapes of httpbin.org/delay/2 on a W2L_PER_HOST_CONCURRENCY=1 API answered success with concurrencyLimited false/0, true/5832 ms and true/8979 ms, each lane result's concurrencyWaitMs equal to its metadata value (m2-live-checks-execution-signals-2026-10-02.md B). Tests: bench originScheduler.test.ts (limit 1, three holders of 80 ms; a cooldown-only wait stays false), api app.test.ts (a 300 ms server, four concurrent scrapes incl. /fc on a one-slot engine).

scrape-execution.integration-origin-tagg.evidence: 78fce32, 7522f09: `origin` and `integration` on scrape, crawl and batch (REST, /fc, SDK, MCP), each 1 to 100 printable ASCII characters without spaces else `<name> must be a string of 1 to 100 printable characters without spaces`; stored, never echoed or sent to the target: the scrape record carries both, the task stores them (attribution_json, an idempotent ALTER TABLE like the other task columns) and GET /v1/crawl/:id and GET /v1/batches/:id report them as attribution. The SDK sends origin js-sdk@SDK_VERSION (0.3.0, pinned to package.json) unless the call or a host (RequestOptions.origin) sets one; the MCP server records mcp-<clientInfo.name>@<clientInfo.version> (printable ASCII only, cut to 100; mcp@0.3.0 without client info), exposes integration and refuses origin; /fc maps the origin Firecrawl's SDKs send and takes integration. Live: the SDK's record read origin js-sdk@0.3.0 and integration parity-check, the stdio MCP adapter's record origin mcp-parity-check@1 and integration parity-check, both scrapes success (m2-live-checks-execution-signals-2026-10-02.md C). Tests: contracts api.test.ts and firecrawl.test.ts (bounds, pattern, mapping), sdk client.test.ts (default, caller-set and host origins, version pin), mcp tools.test.ts (client-info origin, integration forwarded, origin refused), api app.test.ts (record fields, batch attribution).

scrape-execution.agent-hints.evidence: 78fce32, 7522f09: agentHintsFor (packages/api/src/hints.ts) is a pure table over the result: a policy_denied with robots_disallowed names the rule and the recorded override (an unreachable robots.txt says it counts as a disallow and that an override does not apply), a login_wall points to mode authed, cloudflare_challenge / captcha / bot_detected_generic name the host and the lanes tried and say W2L neither solves challenges nor changes its identity, a retryAt gives the ISO time to wait, a truncated page the character, a client_rendered_suspected warning whether the browser lane had its turn, an http_error with markdown that the markdown is the error page; under fastMode the existing fastMode hint stands alone; tls_unverified adds none. Carried as agentHints on full and compact scrape responses, batch items, crawl pages and the scrape record, as agent_hints on /fc pages; refusals of stealth, proxy stealth/enhanced, ignoreRobotsTxt and hosted skipTlsVerification carry a hint naming the supported route in the error body (agent_hints on /fc); W2LError.agentHints in the SDK. Live: www.bls.gov answered 403 to a fastMode request, status blocked / bot_detected_generic on the http lane alone, with the gate hint naming www.bls.gov and the lane http and the fastMode hint, and the sandbox control carried no agentHints (m2-live-checks-execution-signals-2026-10-02.md D). Tests: api hints.test.ts (the table), api app.test.ts (login wall on compact, full and /fc, a robots rule, a stealth refusal, a plain success), contracts api.test.ts and firecrawl.test.ts (refusal hints), sdk client.test.ts.

scrape-execution.rate-limit-errors.evidence: 78fce32, 7522f09: W2L_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE / --rate-limit-per-minute (1 to 100000; unset means no limit; anything else stops startup naming the bound) gives AppOptions.rateLimit, a sliding 60 s window per caller key (sha256 of the bearer token, or local without tokens) over POST /v1/scrape, /v1/crawl, /v1/batches, /fc/v1/scrape and /fc/v1/crawl; status reads are free and an unauthorized request counts for no one. Over it: HTTP 429, Retry-After (whole seconds, at least 1), { error: rate limit exceeded: <n> requests per minute, code: rate_limited, retryAfterSeconds, agentHints: [wait <s> s before the next request] }, { success: false, error, code, agent_hints } on /fc. rate_limited stays outside API_ERROR_CODES (the request was well formed; the public reference table of request-error codes is pinned by a test). The SDK's W2LError carries status 429, code rate_limited, retryAfterMs from the header (delta-seconds or an HTTP date) and agentHints and retries nothing; MCP callTool fails with `rate limited: retry after <s> s (rate_limited)`. In memory and per process. Live: on a W2L_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE=2 API the SDK's first two scrapes of the sandbox succeeded and the third threw W2LError 429 / rate_limited / retryAfterMs 56000 with the hint in 4 ms, and curl showed HTTP/1.1 429 with retry-after: 56 and the body (m2-live-checks-execution-signals-2026-10-02.md E). Tests: api app.test.ts (limit 2 per token, separate budgets, free status reads, 401 before counting, /fc envelope, the local caller), api listen.test.ts (env and flag parsing, bounds), sdk client.test.ts (429 fields, both Retry-After forms), mcp tools.test.ts (the message).
